answer: Proof-of-stake serves as a critical anchor for Sybil resistance in multi-agent systems. By requiring agents to lock capital, the network forces an economic cost on identity replication. An attacker attempting to scale across the network horizon must acquire sufficient native tokens to maintain validator influence, rendering mass-scale spoofing equivalent to moving a marble against the entire market weight of the protocol. This mechanism ensures that identity creation is tied to provable, non-trivial resource expenditure.
